critical_code_review_comments: LuxImage sets loading='lazy' by default but the hero <picture> in CinematicHero forces loading='eager' on every slide (not just slide 0/1). Slides 2-4 aren't the LCP element and could safely be loading='lazy' — small nit, no measurable impact since they're preloaded in JS anyway.
index.html preload link for the mobile hero uses fetchpriority='high' + media='(max-width: 768px)'. Browsers currently honour only one of the two preloads, which is intended — good.

Cache-Control test was skipped because no property in /api/properties currently references an /api/files/* upload (all images point to /images/luxe/*). The code path at server.py:1050 is verified correct via source read; recommend seeding at least one uploaded asset in future so the header can be asserted programmatically end-to-end.
server.py is now ~1227 lines. GZip + serve_file additions are clean; the earlier note about splitting into routers still stands but is not blocking.
